notes: DEPARTMENT CLARIFIED AS INSTRUCTED: the source row says only 'Neurosciences'. He is a NEUROSURGEON, not a neurologist. Apollo's own page title reads 'Best Neurosurgeon in Hyderabad for Brain Tumor & Spine Surgery', the URL segment is /doctors/neurosurgeon/hyderabad/, and his qualification is MCh (Neurosurgery) after MS (General Surgery). This confirms the pattern the brief flagged - JustDial files him under 'Best Neurologists near me in Hyderabad', which is wrong; the hospital page was trusted over the directory. IDENTITY: the surname Ginjupally is highly distinctive and returns exactly one doctor. Matched on name + specialty + hospital (Apollo Health City) + branch (Jubilee Hills, explicit in the Apollo region page title 'Neurosurgeon, Jubilee Hills') + city. BAND HIGH, and the second source is genuinely independent: all apollohospitals.com / apollo247.com pages count once, but amedhahospitals.com is a DIFFERENT hospital group's own site carrying his profile as Senior Neurosurgeon & Spine Surgeon at their Patancheru unit. His own website and LinkedIn are self-published and were NOT counted toward the band. healinindia.gov.in was queried specifically and has no page for him (it returned only an unrelated Apollo Chennai neurosurgeon), so the government route was tried and came back empty. NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED: four searches including two aimed squarely at drdhanunjayaneuro.com and at Amedha's contact details returned no verbatim email or phone for him anywhere. No summary asserted one, so nothing had to be discarded. Do NOT substitute the Apollo group lines 04069321004 / 040-2360-7777 - they are banned group numbers. A human opening drdhanunjayaneuro.com in a browser will very likely find a published practice number there; that is the single highest-value follow-up on this row. JUSTDIAL profile exists and was excluded (call-tracking proxy). EXPERIENCE DISCREPANCY FLAGGED: Apollo says 11 years, his own site says 20+; both are recorded verbatim rather than reconciled. The 11-year figure fits an MCh completed around 2014 and the KIMS-2019 start.
